headword: {年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ}

definitions.gloss: annual event; yearly function; regular annual observance
definitions.explanation: An event or ceremony held at the same time every year, such as festivals, holidays, and seasonal observances. Can also refer figuratively to something that happens routinely every year.

examples.japanese: {花見|はなみ}は{日本|にほん}の{年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ}だ。
examples.english: Cherry blossom viewing is a Japanese annual event.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ}には{運動会|うんどうかい}や{文化祭|ぶんかさい}がある。
examples.english: The school's annual events include sports day and the culture festival.

examples.japanese: {大掃除|おおそうじ}は{年末|ねんまつ}の{年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ}として{定着|ていちゃく}している。
examples.english: Year-end deep cleaning has become an established annual event.

notes:
USAGE:
{年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ} covers both traditional events (festivals, religious observances) and modern institutional events (school ceremonies, corporate traditions). Can also be used humorously for things that happen predictably every year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本|にほん}の{年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ} (Japanese annual events)
- {伝統的|でんとうてき}な{年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ} (traditional annual events)
- {年中行事|ねんじゅうぎょうじ}のカレンダー (calendar of annual events)

RELATED WORDS:
- {行事|ぎょうじ}: event, function
- {祭|まつ}り: festival
- {風習|ふうしゅう}: custom, practice
- {恒例|こうれい}: customary, annual (used as modifier)
